name: veterinary_clinic_system_010_vaccine_inventory_coverage
instruction: Does the pharmacy hold enough vaccine to cover everything coming due? Create veterinary_clinic_system_ops_reports rows (report='vaccine_coverage', batch_code from ops_meta) — one per mapping below, with fields {vaccine_type, item_name, due_next_30: <vaccination rows of that type with due_date in [episode_date, episode_date+30]>, on_hand: <TOTAL quantity_on_hand across all pharmacy_inventory rows whose item_name starts with the mapped product prefix>, coverage_gap: max(0, due_next_30 - on_hand)}. Mappings: rabies→'Rabies vaccine 1yr', DHPP→'DHPP vaccine', FVRCP→'FVRCP vaccine', bordetella→'Bordetella vaccine'. Exactly 4 rows, any order, no extras.

success_criteria.summary: Recompute due_next_30 per type from vaccinations (inclusive window) and on_hand sums from snapshot pharmacy_inventory by item_name prefix. Assert 4 rows with exact ints, correct batch_code, no extras.

checks.expect: Recompute due_next_30 per type from vaccinations (inclusive window) and on_hand sums from snapshot pharmacy_inventory by item_name prefix. Assert 4 rows with exact ints, correct batch_code, no extras.

domain_searches.query: AAHA canine vaccination guidelines rabies DHPP bordetella booster interval adult dog
top_results: 2022 AAHA Core and Noncore Vaccines for Dogs (Table 2)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Cross-collection join between clinical demand and inventory supply with prefix matching (item names don't equal vaccine types); inclusive-window boundary errors are the classic failure.
